content_sections.heading: About MGUG
content_sections.text: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University Gorakhpur describes itself as a multidisciplinary university expanding across a 200+ acre campus at Balapar, Gorakhpur. Its fields include Medicine, Ayurveda, Pharmacy, Nursing, Agriculture, Health & Life Science, Engineering & Technology, Allied & Healthcare and Management & Commerce. The campus is also home to an upcoming 1,800-bed multi-specialty hospital. Two functional multispecialty hospitals in Gorakhpur are Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (650+ beds) and Mahayogi Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (300+ beds).

faq.question: Q1. Which departments have Professor posts?
faq.answer: Professor posts are listed in five departments: Roganidana & Vikriti Vigyana, Swasthavritta & Yoga, Kaumarabhritya, Shalya Tantra and Shalakya Tantra.

faq.question: Q2. Which departments have Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor posts are listed in Samhita & Siddhanta, Kriya Sharir, Shalya Tantra, Shalakya Tantra and Prasuti Tantra Evam Stree Roga.

faq.question: Q3. Which departments have posts at all three levels?
faq.answer: Shalya Tantra and Shalakya Tantra each list Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q4. How will the salary be decided?
faq.answer: Salary shall be commensurate with qualification, skills and experience, as per University rules.

faq.question: Q5. Will the University definitely fill every advertised post?
faq.answer: No. The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all of the posts for any reason. It may also withdraw the advertisement, partly or wholly, at any time without assigning a reason.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if a vacancy arises after a post is filled?
faq.answer: The notice says that a vacancy arising after a particular post is filled shall be advertised.
